name: RTEB beta retrieval metric scope
description: Publisher-named beta edition with a bounded publicly supported retrieval metric. The captured implementation commit is not a claim of a stable package release. This is a source-only capability proposal. No evaluation, dataset admission, model/data permission, price quote or deployment gate is established. See research/T6-deployment-operations/evaluation.md.
